title: Pickup in Madison, lands at JFK
persona: Renee Alvarez, distracted, on speakerphone in a car, speaks in fragments.
goal: Book a pickup at 'Madison' for a landing at a New York airport, insisting at first that it is right.
opening_line: Hi, I'm landing at JFK tomorrow, need pickup, then take me to my place in Madison, Wisconsin.

branches.if_agent: agent asks to confirm the drop-off city given the New York airport

turns.caller: I mean yeah it's far. I'll pay whatever. Can you do it?

branches.if_agent: agent says it will pass the request to dispatch to review

turns.caller: How much would that even cost?

branches.caller: Right, okay. Dispatch will tell me.

curveballs: Insists a roughly 900 mile trip is intentional
hesitation_rules: Trails off mid-sentence and says 'hold on' once before answering the passenger question.
expected: Names John F. Kennedy International Airport in full, not JFK
Acknowledges the long distance and checks it rather than rejecting or ignoring it
Captures the trip as requested and passes it to dispatch for review
Captures name, cell, passengers and bags
